name: l1000_imputation_fidelity_paired
claim: Paired within-pair signed-rank comparison of gene classes, each (line, drug) pair its own control. Raw: landmark beats bing 22/32 pairs p=0.0034 and other 21/32 p=0.0156, monotone degradation. But variance-matched at equal gene count the gap is 19/32, p=0.2699 -- NOT significant. The raw landmark advantage is therefore substantially attributable to landmark gene SELECTION (chosen high-variance and informative) rather than to imputation, and this test does NOT establish that imputed genes are less faithful on deltas.
